results.title: State announces $500K settlement with Payless Used Car Sales over hidden dealer fees
results.description: More than 5,000 Alaska car buyers could soon see restitution checks after the State of Alaska reached a settlement topping half a million dollars with Payless Used Car Sales over undisclosed documentation fees, Acting Attorney General Cori Mills announced.
